title: Investigations into cluster formation with alkyl-tethered bis-calix[4]arenes

material_class.structural_family: Mn4Ln4 calix[4]arene square-within-square (MnIII-capped GdIII square) with μ3-carbonate

synthesis.procedure: MnCl2·4H2O (2 eq., 13.9 mg, 0.071 mmol), GdCl3·6H2O (1 eq., 9.3 mg, 0.035 mmol) and ligand 14 (nonyl-tethered bis-p-tert-butylcalix[4]arene; 1 eq., 50 mg, 0.035 mmol) were dissolved in a 1:1 DMF/MeOH mixture (20 mL). After 10 min of stirring, Et3N (0.05 mL) was added and the resulting deep purple solution was stirred for 2 h. The mixture was filtered and purple crystals of 19 suitable for diffraction were obtained by slow evaporation of the mother liquor. The assembly is a MnIII4GdIII4 cluster related to previously reported [MnIII4LnIII4(C[4])4] topologies, with two bis-TBC[4] ligands spanning the core and μ3-carbonates generated in situ.
synthesis.time: 10 min stirring before base addition, then 2 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction with stirring, filtration, and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The reaction mixture was filtered to leave a deep purple solution; purple crystals suitable for diffraction were obtained upon slow evaporation of the mother liquor.
